single_unit_control.interpretation: Initial root-only fixture produced one CGU; retained as a serial negative control. It cannot establish whether extra slots help parallel work.

multi_unit_probe.interpretation: Old and dynamic-token wrappers both stay near one average CPU when starting on one CPU. The unchanged old wrapper starting on four CPUs averages about two CPUs and has lower walls in this small sample. This supports choosing the budget before rustc starts; it does not establish a full-Lila-build speedup.

prototype_reason: No measured increase in compiler CPU utilization from adding tokens after startup. Exact rejected code retained in the bundle.
scheduler_option: --idle-builds requires --no-test-incremental and LILA_TEST_CODEGEN_JOBS=auto; drain only owned active native tests before uncached Cargo build, retain cached overlap and ordinary default policy.

actual_scheduler_flow_covers: uncached idle opt-in drains before storage admission
